description: Vaara runtime tool-call governance. Hooks run through the vaara binary on PATH when available (any CLI install method works: pip, pipx, Homebrew), falling back to the bundled python3 scripts. PreToolUse classifies, blocks on deny, warns on escalate. Covers shell, web, file mutation (Write/Edit/NotebookEdit), subagent spawning (Task), cross-session messaging (SendMessage) and MCP calls. PostToolUse appends an audit record. SessionStart validates the install and records the configured Article 50(1) disclosure.
